title: Replit is no longer working with Anthropic, CEO says | TechCrunch
summary: Replit, the AI coding platform that has become a favorite of startup founders and developers, is no longer working with Anthropic, the company’s CEO and co-founder Amjad Masad said Thursday while onstage at TechCrunch Disrupt .
